lede: The most consequential thing on the calendar this week happens Monday when a joint session of HARC and P&Z takes up proposed changes to Telluride's Land Use Code and Design Guidelines to bring the town into compliance with the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — whatever language they settle on goes straight to Town Council. The Telluride Hospital District board also meets Thursday to dig into mill levy considerations, a real pressure point as the hospital presses forward on a new facility. Elsewhere, the Open Space Commission works through trail and park projects Monday, and P&Z holds an early feedback session on the Shandoka redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Road.

notable.stake: Wildfire code amendments to Town's Land Use Code head to Council after this.
Mill levy discussion could shape how the hospital district is funded going forward.
NEPA update and trail project decisions affecting public open space access.
Early public shaping of major Town-owned redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Road.
